title: Counting maps is a twisted cubic Gauss sum
claim: Let G = UT3(F4) x| <h>, where h acts by (x, y, z) -> (w^2 x, w^2 y, w z), and let M be a closed orientable 3-manifold with pi = pi1(M). For a surjection psi: pi -> C3 let V = H^1(M; F4 twisted by w^2 through psi) and T(a, b, c) = <a u b u c, [M]> in F4, using the coefficient product w^2 w^2 w^2 = 1. Then T is a symmetric F4-trilinear form; the homomorphisms pi -> G over psi number |Z^1(pi; F4_w)| |B^1(pi; F4_{w^2})|^2 N(T), where N(T) = #{(a, b) in V x V : T(a, b, .) = 0} = |V|^-1 times the sum over a, b, c in V of (-1)^{tr T(a, b, c)}; psi and psi^2 contribute equally, through the automorphism (n, h^e) -> (Frobenius(n), h^{2e}). If H1(M) = Z/3 then |Hom(pi, G)| = 1 + 128 4^d N(T) with d = dim_F4 V. T is the triple cup product of the 3-fold cyclic cover restricted to an eigenspace. So counting maps to G is a statistic of one symmetric cubic form, where the untwisted SL(2,3) obstruction was a bounded family of quadratic forms.
failure_conditions: A closed manifold on which brute-force enumeration of Hom(pi1 M, G) disagrees with 1 + 128 4^d N(T).
An obstruction bimap that is not the contraction of any symmetric, F4-balanced trilinear form with injective pairing, or a cubic character sum that differs from N(T).
The map (n, h^e) -> (Frobenius(n), h^{2e}) is not an automorphism of G, or psi and psi^2 contribute differently.
A control that cannot fail: dropping the obstruction must overcount on some manifold with nonzero T.
foundation_claim_scope: Closed orientable 3-manifolds; the counting formula holds for every such M, and the closed form 1 + 128 4^d N(T) when H1(M) = Z/3. Cited, not proved: central-extension obstruction theory with twisted coefficients (Matei-Suciu 2005), Poincare duality with local coefficients, and the Hopf injection H^2(pi) -> H^2(M). Checked on knot surgeries given by braid closures. No complexity claim here; no P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: brute-force enumeration on six knot surgeries, duality consistency on six manifolds, regression against the probes; standard library; no human or external review
